lunch2_start.name: {name}
lunch2_start.text: *Lunch. Yuna's note is in my pocket. At the end of the hall, Seoyeon heads upstairs with her lunchbox while Dain waves from the direction of the snack bar. I stop at the three-way junction.*

lunch2_choice.name: {name}
choices: Follow Yuna's note to the library annex
Go to the snack bar with Dain

lunch2_seo_1b.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_1b.text: *It's my first time on the rooftop. A whistle from the field carries up past the railing as Seoyeon spreads her lunch out on a folding chair.*

lunch2_seo_2b.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b.text: You actually came up here. Bold.

lunch2_seo_2b_dain.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b_dain.text: Yesterday you were headed for the store. Today you came all the way up here.

lunch2_seo_3b_dain.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_3b_dain.text: Dain dragged me off yesterday. Today, I wanted to come up here myself.

lunch2_seo_5b_dain.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_5b_dain.text: The breeze is nice. And I kept thinking about your lunchbox.

lunch2_seo_2b_yuna.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b_yuna.text: You got a note and still came to the rooftop.

lunch2_seo_3b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_3b_yuna.text: Yesterday was the quiet option, so today I got curious about your side.

lunch2_seo_5b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_5b_yuna.text: I was curious what lunch on the rooftop with the student council president would be like.

lunch2_seo_6b_yuna.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_6b_yuna.text: *She taps the edge of the lunchbox lid with her chopsticks.* Strangely enough, that makes sense.

lunch2_seo_1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_1.text: *The rooftop. Same spot as yesterday. Seoyeon is setting out her lunchbox.*

lunch2_seo_7.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_7.text: *The moment Seoyeon opens the lunchbox lid, the rooftop door clanks open. Dain slips through the gap.*

lunch2_seo_11.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_11.text: Come on, you don't need a permit to eat lunch! — Oh, is that a lunchbox? That looks good!

lunch2_seo_12.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_12.text: *Dain sits down without hesitation. Seoyeon's chopsticks circle above the rolled omelette, miss, then return to where they started.*

lunch2_seo_13.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_13.text: We met yesterday! He's a lively one, isn't he, President?

lunch2_seo_13b.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_13b.text: Oh! You're the council president? Nice to meet you!

lunch2_seo_13b_b.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_13b_b.text: *She turns the lunchbox compartment toward {name}.* She is lively.

lunch2_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_14.text: *When Dain leans toward the lunchbox, Seoyeon pulls it a little closer to herself.* Looks like you two are already close.

lunch2_seo_15.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_15.text: We're in the same class. And now you two know each other too.

lunch2_seo_17.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_17.text: *Dain's hand stops over a sausage, and Seoyeon's chopsticks tap the edge of the lunchbox twice.*

lunch2_seo_19.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_19.text: *She looks at the corner of {name}'s mouth.*

lunch2_seo_20.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_20.text: You have something on your lip. Hold still.

lunch2_seo_choice.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_choice.text: *A finger wrapped in a wet wipe moves toward my mouth.*
choices: I can handle this much myself.

lunch2_seo_c1_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c1_1.text: *She wipes away the grain of rice, then folds the used side of the wipe inward.*

lunch2_seo_c1_2_b.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_c1_2_b.text: *Dain looks back and forth between us, her hand still suspended on its way to the lunchbox.*

lunch2_seo_c1_3.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_c1_3.text: You picked the rice off for them yourself?

lunch2_seo_c1_3_b.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c1_3_b.text: *She folds the wet wipe into a square.* It was a grain of rice.

lunch2_seo_c1_5.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c1_5.text: *Seoyeon picks up her water bottle but doesn't open it. Only the label crumples in her hand.*

lunch2_seo_end_c1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_end_c1.text: *Dain nudges a folding-chair leg twice with the toe of her sneaker. Seoyeon places the folded wet wipe on the lunchbox lid.*

lunch2_seo_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c2_1.text: *I wipe my mouth with the back of my hand.*

lunch2_seo_c2_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c2_2.text: You'll only smear it if you wipe it yourself.

lunch2_seo_c2_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c2_3.text: *Her hands slip twice while lining up the lunchbox lid. It clicks shut on the third try.*

lunch2_seo_end_c2.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_end_c2.text: *The rice mark is still on the back of my hand. Seoyeon unties the lunchbox strap and ties it again.*

lunch2_dain_1b.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b.text: *To the store with Dain. First order of business: rock-paper-scissors match.*

lunch2_dain_1b_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b_seo.text: *To the store with Dain. Yesterday it was a lunchbox. Today the smell of bread hits first.*

lunch2_dain_2b_seo.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2b_seo.text: Oh, so it's my side today instead of the president's lunchbox?

lunch2_dain_3b_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3b_seo.text: The president dragged me off yesterday, so today I wanted to see what spending lunch with you was like.

lunch2_dain_4b_seo.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_4b_seo.text: Yes! No takebacks. One round, with a soboro bun on the line!

lunch2_dain_1b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b_yuna.text: *To the store with Dain. Yesterday it was a quiet library. Today the smell of bread and the noise hit first.*

lunch2_dain_2b_yuna.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2b_yuna.text: Hey, you spent yesterday in the library, so today you're actually going to have some fun with me, right?

lunch2_dain_3b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3b_yuna.text: If I went somewhere quiet, I should try somewhere loud too.

lunch2_dain_4b_yuna.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_4b_yuna.text: Nice! I respect the balance. Then let's play a round!

lunch2_dain_1.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1.text: *To the snack bar with Dain. A rematch of yesterday's rock-paper-scissors.*

lunch2_dain_3.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3.text: You said the same thing yesterday.

lunch2_dain_4b.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_4b.text: Obviously! I'm actually really good at this!

lunch2_dain_8.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_8.text: Okay, okay. Two soboro buns, please!

lunch2_dain_9.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_9.text: *We buy bread and stand by the hallway windows. Seoyeon passes from the opposite direction with her lunch bag.*

lunch2_dain_10.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_10.text: *Seoyeon glances at me standing beside Dain, then walks on. With a bite of soboro in my mouth, I forget to chew.*

lunch2_dain_11.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_11.text: Hey, what's with the president? Why's she staring?

lunch2_dain_13.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_13.text: Hmm. Are you close with the president too?

lunch2_dain_13_b.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_13_b.text: *She takes a big bite of the soboro bread. Crumbs fall onto her uniform sleeve.*

lunch2_dain_choice.name: Dain
choices: She just showed me around the school?

lunch2_dain_c1_1.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_c1_1.text: *Still holding the soboro between her teeth, she folds the edge of the wrapper. Her chewing stops.*

lunch2_dain_c2_1.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_c2_1.text: *She takes a bite of the soboro and watches Seoyeon's reflection recede in the glass door of the school store.*

lunch2_dain_c3_1.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_c3_1.text: Hey, don't laugh! *She breaks the soboro bun in half and holds out one piece.* Here. Eat this.

lunch2_dain_c3_2.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_c3_2.text: *She folds the soboro wrapper three times until it's only two finger joints wide.*

lunch2_dain_end.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end.text: *While Dain chews her soboro, the glass door Seoyeon passed through is still swinging.*

lunch2_dain_end_b.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_b.text: *Fifth-period PE. While running on the field, I collide with the guy beside me when he stops short. My elbow is scraped—not badly, but it's bleeding a little.*

lunch2_dain_end_c.name: PE Teacher
lunch2_dain_end_c.text: Head to the nurse's office and get that cleaned up.

lunch2_dain_end_d.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_d.text: *I open the nurse's office door. Same antiseptic smell as yesterday.*

lunch2_dain_end_e.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_e.text: *She looks up from the medical chart.* Oh, yesterday's transfer student.

lunch2_dain_end_ins4_first.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins4_first.text: *I open the nurse's office door. The unfamiliar smell of antiseptic hits my nose.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins5_first.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins5_first.text: *She closes the medical chart.* First time in the nurse's office? You're the transfer student, right?

lunch2_dain_end_g.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_g.text: Back again? Trying to become a regular?

lunch2_dain_end_h.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_h.text: *She jokes as she talks, but checks the dirt around my elbow first.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins7_first.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins7_first.text: First time, huh? Happens. Come on, let's clean it up.

lunch2_dain_end_ins8_first.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins8_first.text: *With gloved fingers, the nurse brushes the dirt away from my elbow first.*

lunch2_dain_end_i.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_i.text: *She takes out disinfectant and gauze, holding the gauze beneath my elbow.*

lunch2_dain_end_j.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_j.text: This might sting a little. Relax your arm.

lunch2_dain_end_k.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_k.text: *A disinfectant-soaked cotton pad sweeps over the wound. The inside of my elbow prickles.*

lunch2_dain_end_l.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_l.text: *She applies a bandage.* Don't move. There.

lunch2_dain_end_m.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_m.text: *She gestures for me to bend my elbow once.*

lunch2_dain_end_n.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_n.text: Try bending it. Does it pull or sting?

lunch2_dain_end_o.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_o.text: *Even when I bend and straighten my arm, the edge of the bandage stays flat.*

lunch2_dain_end_p.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_p.text: It's a trick I learned at the hospital. Bandages last longer when you apply them this way over a joint.

lunch2_dain_end_q.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_q.text: *The bandage doesn't crease, even when I bend my elbow.*

lunch2_dain_end_r.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_r.text: *As I check the bandage, I notice a pale green notebook jutting out of the desk drawer. The first line on the open page reads, 'To you, that day—' The nurse closes the drawer.*

lunch2_dain_end_s.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_s.text: *She glances at the drawer once.* Forget what you just saw. I'll tell you one thing instead: I like cocoa better than coffee.

lunch2_dain_end_t.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_t.text: *Even after she finishes answering, her hand stays pressed to the drawer handle.*

lunch2_dain_end_u.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_u.text: *She takes her hand off the drawer handle.* That's worth one secret, isn't it?

lunch2_dain_end_v.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_v.text: *The nurse closes the drawer. The handle is pressed once more.*

lunch2_dain_end_w.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_w.text: All done. Get back to class, and keep it dry today.

lunch2_dain_end_x.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_x.text: Do I need to change it again tomorrow?

lunch2_dain_end_y.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_y.text: *The school nurse stops folding the bandage wrapper and looks at {name}.*

lunch2_dain_end_z.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_z.text: Come back if an edge lifts or it gets wet. If it looks fine, leave it as is.

lunch2_dain_end_b2.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_b2.text: *The nurse records the time she applied the bandage in the medical log.*

lunch2_dain_end_c2.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_c2.text: If it bothers you during class, tell your PE teacher. Otherwise, come during a break.

lunch2_dain_end_d2.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_d2.text: *At the end of the record, she writes, 'Elbow flexion checked.'*

lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short1.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short1.text: There, all done. Next time, look where you're going before you run.

lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short2.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short2.text: *I leave the nurse's office with the bandage in place. Its edges stay flat even when I bend my elbow.*

lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short3.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short3.text: *The bell rings as I step into the hall. The fresh bandage catches on the edge of my sleeve, then settles back into place.*

lunch2_yuna_1.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_1.text: *The library annex is older than the main building, and almost no students are around. At the top of the stairs, Yuna stands at the end of the hall, leaning against the wall with a book.*

lunch2_yuna_7.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_7.text: You were with the loud one. That's more fun, isn't it?

lunch2_yuna_8.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_8.text: Sometimes I need somewhere to escape to.

lunch2_yuna_5_seo.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_5_seo.text: Yesterday you were with the president.

lunch2_yuna_6_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_6_seo.text: Today you were the one who called me here.

lunch2_yuna_8_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_8_seo.text: That made me want to come even more.

lunch2_yuna_4_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_4_yuna.text: You even sent me a note this time.

lunch2_yuna_5_yuna.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_5_yuna.text: Yesterday was quiet too. Today as well?

lunch2_yuna_6_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_6_yuna.text: Yesterday was comfortable. So I came back.

lunch2_yuna_8_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_8_yuna.text: Yeah. Sitting next to you wasn't uncomfortable.

lunch2_yuna_9.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_9.text: *She turns a page and smooths the rumpled cushion on the opposite sofa with her palm.*

lunch2_yuna_11.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_11.text: *Yuna leads the way deeper into the annex. At the end of a hall where our footsteps echo softly is a small room, sunlight slipping through old curtains all the way to the bottom shelves.*

lunch2_yuna_13.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_13.text: What is this place? Some kind of secret reading room?

lunch2_yuna_14.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_14.text: Almost no one knows about this place.

lunch2_yuna_15.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_15.text: *She sits on the sofa, sets her bag on the floor, and leaves one space open.*

lunch2_yuna_16.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_16.text: There used to be one other person who came here.

lunch2_yuna_17_b.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_17_b.text: *The end of her bookmark slowly disappears between the pages. Yuna doesn't turn to the next one.*

lunch2_yuna_choice.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_choice.text: *She doesn't continue after 'used to.' Yuna pushes the tip of the bookmark farther into the book.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_1.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_1.text: She transferred away. A year ago.

lunch2_yuna_c1_2.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_2.text: *Her finger presses firmly on the end of the bookmark.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_4.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_4.text: *She pushes the bookmark deeper into the book, folding the corner of a page. She doesn't smooth it out.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_6.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_6.text: I don't know. Whether she didn't, or couldn't.

lunch2_yuna_c1_7.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_7.text: *Yuna raises the book to hide the lower half of her face. I read only the worn gold lettering on the open spine.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_9.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_9.text: Maybe they had to leave in a rush? Sometimes things just slip through the cracks like that.

lunch2_yuna_c1_12.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_12.text: *With the bookmark still in place, Yuna doesn't turn the page. She only smooths the bent corner with her thumb.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_14.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_14.text: *My fingertip traces the worn gold lettering on the book's spine.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c2_1.text: *When I sit beside her, Yuna takes a book from her own stack and sets it down in front of me.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_4.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c2_4.text: *I open the book. Our pages turn in alternating beats as the window-frame shadow moves to the end of the sofa.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_6.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c2_6.text: This is why I like it here.

lunch2_yuna_c2_8.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c2_8.text: It's quiet. — But I'm not alone.

lunch2_yuna_c2_9.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c2_9.text: *She turns back toward the shelves, but her book stays open to the same page for a long time.*

lunch2_yuna_end.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_end.text: *Before closing the door, I look back. Yuna has reopened the page where she stopped at “used to.”*
